body: ### APLD is expected to report earnings to fall 357.00% to -23 cents per share on August 20. ## Applied Digital Corporation (APLD) Q3 Fiscal 2026 Earnings Recap: Revenue Surges on AI Data Center Demand. Applied Digital Corporation (APLD), a designer and operator of data centers for AI, cloud, and blockchain workloads, released fiscal Q3 2026 results (ended February 28, 2026) on April 8, 2026. Investors watch these earnings for execution on multi-year leases, capacity expansions, and path to profitability, as APLD navigates capital-intensive growth in a competitive data center market. For the fiscal third quarter ended February 28, 2026, Applied Digital reported total revenue of $126.6 million, a 139% increase from $52.9 million in the prior-year quarter. On an adjusted basis, the company posted net income of $33.2 million or $0.09 per diluted share, versus an adjusted net loss of $2.6 million or $0.01 per share a year ago.

# Applied Digital Set to Report Q3 Earnings: Hold or Fold the Stock? **Applied Digital** APLD is slated to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 results on April 8. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for fiscal third-quarter revenues is pegged at $75.06 million, indicating year-over-year growth of 41.83%. ### Applied Digital Corporation Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise. The combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy) or 3 (Hold) increases the odds of an earnings beat. Applied Digital is expected to have entered the third quarter of fiscal 2026, navigating the early stages of a revenue model shift, as tenant fit-out contributions from the prior period normalized and the company's lease-driven revenue stream began assuming greater significance. Applied Digital’s shares have plunged 21.2% in the past three months, while the broader Zacks Finance sector and the Zacks Financial-Miscellaneous Services industry have declined 7.6% and 21.7%, respectively.
